name: Tile Rewriter
description: Causes a tile to be changed to a different tile.

fields.name: Tile Value
fields.description: The value of the tile that will appear.

fields.name: Player Count Condition
fields.description: Determines the minimum number of active players required for tile changed.

0.name: Always
0.description: Allows tile generation regardless of player count.

1.name: 3+ Players
1.description: Allows tile generation when at least 3 players are active.

2.name: 4 Players
2.description: Allows tile generation when all 4 players are active.

3.name: 2+ Players
3.description: Allows tile generation when at least 2 players are active.

fields.name: Special Effect Type
fields.description: Selects the effect created when the tile rewrite is processed.

fields.name: Tile Layer
fields.description: Determines which layer the new tile appears on.

fields.name: Activation Mode
fields.description: Controls when and how the tile rewrite is activated.

0.name: Single Use
0.description: The rewrite is not repeated after successful execution.

1.name: Toggle
1.description: Activates the tile rewrite when a player approaches, provided the Activation Variable is 0.

2.name: Conditional Toggle
2.description: Uses additional conditions to control the rewrite and restoration behavior.

3.name: Toggle Unknown
3.description: The behavior has not yet been identified.

fields.name: Enable Special Effect
fields.description: Enables or disables the effect selected by Effect Type.

fields.name: Activation Variable
fields.description: Variable that activates the tile change. Activated when player is nearby if set to 0.
